mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.5% (historical average) compresses discount rates and increases liquidity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 3.5% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve monetary tightening that leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.3% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) and low industrial production (INDPRO < 118.0) indicate a deteriorating economic cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% AND INDPRO < 118.0 over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing boom (HOUST > 2000) and strong retail sales (RSAFS > 350000), the economy is in a growth regime, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
regime_hint: housing boom and strong retail sales
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 2000 AND RSAFS > 350000 over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts (HOUST) level (all else equal) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST is above its 1-year moving average over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE exceeding 5.5% signals a weak labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production (INDPRO) level (all else equal) indicates robust economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO is above its 1-year moving average over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
